title: Person: Brother Michael
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Brother Michael

anchor.prefix:
led out:

 —Hello! It’s young Dedalus! What’s up?

 —The sky is up, Brother Michael said.

 He was a fellow out of the third of grammar and, while Stephen was undressing, he asked
anchor.suffix:
to bring him a round of buttered toast.

 —Ah, do! he said.

 —Butter you up! said Brother Michael. You’ll get your walking papers in the morning when the doctor comes.

 —Will I?
